description: The complete published record for one product: identity, typed specifications with the provenance of each figure, the full spec table, orderable units and their part numbers, size and model tables, images, documents available on request, and pricing. Accepts a slug from the product URL or an F21 part number. Fields the factory has not supplied are returned as available on request rather than omitted, so an absent value is never mistaken for a value of zero.

sku.description: An F21 part number such as F21-NF-20, or a product slug such as product-20l-nato-steel-fuel-can

name: get_product_details
title: Get one Fortitude21 product
